source.source: NASA SRTM 1 arc-second (SRTMGL1), public domain, served by Open Topo Data (https://www.opentopodata.org), dataset 'srtm30m', bilinear interpolation
source.vertical_reference: SRTM heights are metres above the EGM96 geoid; the supplied model's vertical datum is unknown, so the backdrop is approximate
source.use_in_tool: distant mountain backdrop drawn only in the observer view; never used in any check; cells inside the supplied model's extent are dropped

transformation: equirectangular about the earth anchor: x = (lon - -123.1207) * 111320.0 * cos(49.2827 deg), y = (lat - 49.2827) * 110574.0; checked against 8 OpenStreetMap footprints, max residual 0.1 m; absolute accuracy inherits OpenStreetMap
note: APPROXIMATE distant backdrop (SRTM via Open Topo Data), observer view only, not part of the supplied model, never checked against
